Package net.sf.sevenzipjbinding

This package contains the basic enumerations, interfaces and classes of the main SevenZipJBinding interface.

Package net.sf.sevenzipjbinding Description

This package contains the basic enumerations, interfaces and classes of the main SevenZipJBinding interface. This interface is a mapping of the original C++ interface and is therefore not very convenient for Java developers. There is also a simplified interface, which provides simpler but reduced access to the 7-Zip library.
  • SevenZip — the entry point of the library.
Since:
4.65-1

Boris Brodski
